propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple lifecycle concerns (identity transitions, state management, ID re-keying, tombstones) that must be extracted into a cohesive policy owner
Production rich-text convergence bypasses policy by mutating inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings(), requiring a narrow facade operation for supported mutations

Lifecycle operations must preserve at-most-one identity by targeted reverse-key pops and handle confirmed 404 retirements, numeric-ID re-keys, and comment-ID append-only semantics without changing existing failure modes
A new BindingStore.note_rich_emit() operation must match current hash/counter/save behavior with fail-open semantics for missing bindings, replacing direct repository mutation as the production seam
Public facade signatures and all_bindings() shallow semantics must remain unchanged; no caller receives direct writable repository access
Lifecycle state transitions must reload through real repository and remain compatible with legacy entries lacking immutable-ID fields without rewrite
